title: The Iran War's Devastating Butterfly Effect

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空中走过七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费者产品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我要测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

I use a different starting word every day.

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮您理解世界并充分过好每一天。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是蕾切尔·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: The war in Iran has had some visible consequences like skyrocketing energy costs and higher gas prices.
sentences.zh: 伊朗战争带来了一些显而易见的后果，比如急剧飙升的能源成本和更高的天然气价格。

sentences.en: But the effects of this war are often far less obvious and much more serious for the world's most vulnerable people.
sentences.zh: 但对于世界上最脆弱的人群来说，这场战争的影响往往远不那么显眼，却要严重得多。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Peter Goodman tells us about what he learned on a recent trip to Somalia and why the system of global aid is no longer in a position to help.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事彼得·古德曼向我们讲述了他在索马里近期之行中的见闻，以及为什么全球援助体系已不再有能力提供帮助。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, June 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月10日，星期三。

sentences.en: Peter Goodman, welcome back to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 彼得·古德曼，欢迎回到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: So Peter, we're now 101 days into the war with Iran.
sentences.zh: 那么彼得，我们现在进入对伊战争的第101天了。

sentences.en: And we have talked a lot on the show about its effect on gas prices.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中讨论过很多关于它对油价的影响。

sentences.en: But you cover global supply chains, which means that you've gone all over the world, you've reported on how something gets from point A to point B,
sentences.zh: 但你负责报道全球供应链，这意味着你去过世界各地，报道过货物是如何从A点运到B点的，

sentences.en: and you have focused a lot on all the people who are affected in between.
sentences.zh: 而且你把很多注意力放在了中间所有受到影响的人身上。

sentences.en: So for that reason, we wanted to ask you for your take on how the war has disrupted things all over the world in less visible ways.
sentences.zh: 因此，出于这个原因，我们想听听你对这场战争如何以不那么明显的方式扰乱世界各地的看法。

sentences.en: Well, first of all, the price of energy goes so far beyond putting gas in your car, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，能源价格的影响远不止给汽车加油那么简单，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, we've seen cooking fuel get scarce in India, in South America.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们看到印度和南美洲的烹饪燃料变得稀缺。

sentences.en: We've seen the Philippines limit the hours that people can work in office buildings to limit the cost of air conditioning.
sentences.zh: 我们看到菲律宾限制了人们在办公大楼里工作的时间，以减少空调费用。

sentences.en: We've seen helium, which is used by computer chip factories from Taiwan, get expensive and hard to secure.
sentences.zh: 我们看到被台湾电脑芯片工厂使用的氦气变得昂贵且难以获取。

sentences.en: The ripple effects of this are almost infinite.
sentences.zh: 这一切的连锁反应几乎是无限的。

sentences.en: Reminds me of the butterfly effect.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了蝴蝶效应。

sentences.en: A butterfly flaps its wings in one place, and you see a tidal wave in another.
sentences.zh: 一只蝴蝶在一个地方扇动翅膀，你在另一个地方就会看到滔天巨浪。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, this particular butterfly is coming out of the Strait of Hormuz, which is the conduit for something like one-fifth of the world's oil supply
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这只特殊的蝴蝶正从霍尔木兹海峡飞出，那是占世界石油供应约五分之一的通道，

sentences.en: and something like a third of major forms of fertilizer, which affects how much food that we can grow.
sentences.zh: 也是占主要化肥供应约三分之一的通道，这会影响我们能种植多少粮食。

sentences.en: And so the consequences of this particular flapping of wings are especially enormous.
sentences.zh: 因此，这次扇动翅膀所带来的后果尤其巨大。

sentences.en: In addition to these kind of ripple effects, there are also significant issues of life and death.
sentences.zh: 除了这些连锁反应之外，还有重大的生死问题。

sentences.en: And that's what I've been focusing on.
sentences.zh: 这也是我一直关注的重点。

sentences.en: I've been looking at 60 or so countries that tend to suffer from malnutrition, even in the best of times.
sentences.zh: 我一直在关注大约60个即使在太平盛世也往往饱受营养不良之苦的国家。

sentences.en: And every time there's a shock, we have reason to worry.
sentences.zh: 而且每次发生冲击，我们都有理由担心。

sentences.en: And now we have a big reason to worry, because the price of food and fertilizer is going up very quickly in many parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有了充分的理由担心，因为粮食和化肥价格在世界许多地方正急剧上涨。

sentences.en: And we, in wealthy countries, decided to dismantle large parts of the international humanitarian relief system.
sentences.zh: 而我们这些富裕国家，决定拆除国际人道主义救援体系的大部分机构。

sentences.en: This is the safety net that dates all the way back to the end of World War II.
sentences.zh: 这是可以追溯到二战结束时的安全网。

sentences.en: And then we, in the United States, and Israel, decided to launch this war.
sentences.zh: 然后我们，美国和以色列，决定发动这场战争。

sentences.en: The aid cuts that you referred to, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你提到的援助削减，即美国

sentences.en: aid cuts, of course, refer to USAID.
sentences.zh: 的援助削减，当然是指美国国际开发署（USAID）。

sentences.en: We covered this on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中报道过这一点。

sentences.en: That was something that happened very early on in the second Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 那是特朗普政府第二任期非常早期发生的事情。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a critically important part of the story, but it's far from the only part.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是故事中至关重要的一部分，但远非全部。

sentences.en: I mean, in addition, major European donors, like the United Kingdom, like Germany, have also pulled back.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，此外，像英国、德国这样主要的欧洲捐助国也退出了。

sentences.en: And this is in part because the Trump administration has pressed European allies to spend more money on their own defense
sentences.zh: 这部分是因为特朗普政府一直向欧洲盟友施压，要求他们把更多资金花在自身防务上，

sentences.en: or financing NATO, as opposed to, in the Trump view, just relying on the good graces and largesse of the United States.
sentences.zh: 或者资助北约，而不是像特朗普所认为的那样，仅仅依赖美国的善意和慷慨解囊。

sentences.en: And so, in London, in Berlin, major governments have also cut back significantly on overseas aid.
sentences.zh: 因此，在伦敦、在柏林，主要政府也大幅削减了海外援助。

sentences.en: And that has contributed to this picture.
sentences.zh: 这促成了当前的局面。

sentences.en: So, let me give you an example.
sentences.zh: 那么，我举个例子。

sentences.en: You know, four years ago, when Russia invaded Ukraine, there were similar fears about a fertilizer crisis and hits to food security.
sentences.zh: 你知道，四年前俄罗斯入侵乌克兰时，人们对化肥危机和粮食安全受到的冲击也有过类似的担忧。

sentences.en: Because Russia and Ukraine together produce a lot of grain.
sentences.zh: 因为俄罗斯和乌克兰共同生产大量谷物。

sentences.en: They also produce a lot of the peace parts for fertilizers.
sentences.zh: 它们还生产大量化肥的零部件。

sentences.en: And so, from Egypt to Indonesia, there were worries about the price of bread and grains.
sentences.zh: 因此，从埃及到印度尼西亚，人们都在担心面包和谷物的价格。

sentences.en: And that the energy prices did go up because of that war, too.
sentences.zh: 而且那场战争也确实导致能源价格上涨了。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: They were not unfounded, right?
sentences.zh: 这些担忧并非毫无根据，对吧？

sentences.en: No, no, these were real effects.
sentences.zh: 不，不，这些都是真实的影响。

sentences.en: In fact, I went to Nigeria back in 2023 to write about the shock to the fertilizer situation, and it was pretty dire.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我曾在2023年去过尼日利亚，报道化肥局势受到的冲击，当时的情况相当严峻。

sentences.en: But here's what was different.
sentences.zh: 但不同之处在于：

sentences.en: There was $43 billion in international humanitarian relief, led by $17 billion from the United States,
sentences.zh: 当时有430亿美元的国际人道主义救援资金，其中以美国提供的170亿美元为首，

sentences.en: that got marshaled to take on this crisis and staved off famine in places like Sudan, South Sudan, Ethiopia, Afghanistan, and Somalia.
sentences.zh: 被筹集起来应对这场危机，并在苏丹、南苏丹、埃塞俄比亚、阿富汗和索马里等地避免了饥荒。

sentences.en: So, when the war in Ukraine shocked the world economy, the humanitarian system more or less worked.
sentences.zh: 所以，当乌克兰战争震撼世界经济时，人道主义体系或多或少发挥了作用。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then came the war in Iran.
sentences.zh: 然后就迎来了伊朗战争。

sentences.en: And this time, we're in a moment where the politics are completely different, and much of the developed wealthy world is pulling back.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，我们处于一个政治环境完全不同的时刻，大部分发达富裕国家都在退缩。

sentences.en: And so, now we're in a situation where we've got tremendous need for aid.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在我们的处境是：我们对援助有着极大的需求。

sentences.en: We've got climate crises around the world, and yet we've seen international humanitarian relief drop from $43 billion in 2022 to $28 billion last year, and it's still coming down.
sentences.zh: 我们面临着世界各地的气候危机，然而我们看到国际人道主义救援资金从2022年的430亿美元下降到去年的280亿美元，而且还在继续下降。

sentences.en: Do you feel like the U.S.'s allies looked at the cuts that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你觉得美国的盟友们看到美国

sentences.en: was making to USAID and thought, okay, well, if the U.S.
sentences.zh: 对美国国际开发署的削减时会想，好吧，既然美国

sentences.en: is cutting it, we can cut it too.
sentences.zh: 在削减，我们也可以削减。

sentences.en: Like, do you think the U.S.
sentences.zh: 就像，你认为美国

sentences.en: almost gave our NATO allies permission to cut their own humanitarian programs?
sentences.zh: 几乎是变相默许了我们的北约盟友削减他们自己的人道主义项目吗？

sentences.en: Yes and no.
sentences.zh: 难说得很。

sentences.en: I mean, look, the Nordic countries and the European Union as a bloc are still holding the line on overseas aid.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，北欧国家和作为一个整体的欧盟仍然在海外援助问题上坚守阵地。

sentences.en: And yet, the political appeal in many countries, and especially this one, the United States, of saying, hey,
sentences.zh: 然而，在许多国家，尤其是这个国家——美国，有一种政治诉求说，嘿，

sentences.en: how about we solve problems at home instead of trying to save starving kids in some faraway place that I'll never visit, that has a lot of political punch.
sentences.zh: 与其试图拯救某个我永远不会去、遥远地方正在挨饿的孩子，我们为什么不先解决国内的问题呢？这在政治上很有煽动力。

sentences.en: Now,
sentences.zh: 现在，

sentences.en: I think it's important to remember that while politically it's sometimes very convenient for people to attack overseas aid and treat it like it's just sort of a discretionary type of charity,
sentences.zh: 我认为重要的是要记住，虽然在政治上，人们有时会觉得攻击海外援助、把它当作一种随意的慈善行为非常方便，

sentences.en: the people who designed it and continue to advocate for this system have argued that, you know, in addition to the humanitarian aims,
sentences.zh: 但那些设计并继续倡导这一系统的人一直主张，除了人道主义目标之外，

sentences.en: it's also been an instrument of foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 它一直也是外交政策的一个工具。

sentences.en: It's traditionally been about national security policy.
sentences.zh: 它传统上一直关乎国家安全政策。

sentences.en: And while it might be tempting to say, well, what do people in some faraway place have to do with the voter in Ohio or New Jersey or wherever,
sentences.zh: 虽然人们可能会忍不住说，某个遥远地方的人跟俄亥俄州、新泽西州或其他地方的选民有什么关系，

sentences.en: history tells us that when you leave tens of millions of people in a situation where they don't have enough food to eat and their already difficult lives become that much more traumatic,
sentences.zh: 但历史告诉我们，当数十万人陷入没有足够食物吃、本已艰难的生活变得更加痛苦的境地时，

sentences.en: that can play out a lot of different ways, but they're not good.
sentences.zh: 这可能会以许多不同的方式爆发，而且绝非好事。

sentences.en: First of all, you could end up with the mother of all migration crisis.
sentences.zh: 首先，你最终可能会迎来史上规模最大的移民危机。

sentences.en: Now, I'm not here to fearmonger about immigration,
sentences.zh: 现在，我不是在这里制造关于移民的恐慌，

sentences.en: but if your perspective is you don't want millions of people heading to the Darien Gap in Panama or streaming toward places like Greece and Turkey and on toward northern Europe,
sentences.zh: 但如果你的愿景是不希望数以百万计的人涌向巴拿马的达连峡谷，或者成群结队地前往希腊、土耳其并继续向北欧前进，

sentences.en: well, you got to give a thought to what's going to happen if you remove all of this aid and then add on an enormous crisis.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你必须好好想想，如果你撤走所有这些援助，然后又加上一场巨大的危机，将会发生什么。

sentences.en: You're describing a bunch of reasons why people risk everything to travel to other countries in search of a better life.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的是人们为了追求更好生活而冒着一切风险前往其他国家的种种原因。

sentences.en: Hunger, climate change, desperation, and all of that, as you're describing, is poised to get even worse because of the shocks caused by the Iran war.
sentences.zh: 饥饿、气候变化、绝望，所有这一切正如你所描述的，由于伊朗战争带来的冲击，将变得更加糟糕。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: People are not going to go to where they can better support their families, and the worse the crisis gets, the more likely that people will be on the move.
sentences.zh: 人们不会去那些能更好地养家糊口的地方，危机越严重，人们踏上迁徙之路的可能性就越大。

sentences.en: It's also worth reminding people that, you know, al-Shabaab, which is this al-Qaeda-affiliated Islamist militia, is active in the Horn of Africa, and certainly trauma, like famine,
sentences.zh: 同样值得提醒大家的是，青年党（al-Shabaab）——这个与基地组织有关联的伊斯兰民兵组织——在非洲之角很活跃，而诸如饥荒之类的创伤，

sentences.en: provides recruits.
sentences.zh: 为他们提供了新兵来源。

sentences.en: It's another societal shock.
sentences.zh: 这是又一次社会冲击。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There are a lot of reasons why it might be bad for a country to become, for lack of a better term, a failed state.
sentences.zh: 一个国家沦为——借用一个不太恰当的词——失败国家，会有很多理由证明这对该国是不利的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: What happens when a state sinks into absolute dysfunction?
sentences.zh: 当一个国家陷入绝对的功能失调时会发生什么？

sentences.en: That can play out a lot of different ways.
sentences.zh: 这可能会以许多不同的方式上演。

sentences.en: They're generally not good, and it's not tenable for the rest of the world to pretend that it's living in some sort of giant gated community.
sentences.zh: 它们通常都不是好事，而且世界其他地方假装自己生活在某种巨大的封闭式高档社区里，这也是不可持续的。

sentences.en: You know, gated community as national security policy tends not to work very well.
sentences.zh: 你知道，把封闭式高档社区作为国家安全政策往往并不能很好地奏效。

sentences.en: So, you know, I was already thinking about places I could go to illustrate the crisis from rising fertilizer prices and malnutrition,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我当时已经在考虑我可以去哪些地方来阐明化肥价格上涨和营养不良带来的危机，

sentences.en: and I was talking to aid groups around the world, and then I had a conversation with Mercy Corps,
sentences.zh: 我正在与世界各地的援助组织交谈，然后我与慈怀机构（Mercy Corps）进行了交流，

sentences.en: this American aid organization that I had known from traveling with them in Nigeria to write about the fertilizer crisis back in 2023.
sentences.zh: 这是一个美国援助组织，我2023年在尼日利亚与他们一同旅行以报道化肥危机时就认识了他们。

sentences.en: And they suggested that I think about going to Somalia, a country that is especially susceptible to climate change, drought.
sentences.zh: 他们建议我考虑去索马里，这是一个对气候变化和干旱极其敏感的国家。

sentences.en: My reflexive take on that was that Somalia was not a place on my map of potential places to do reporting because it's traditionally thought of as very difficult, dangerous.
sentences.zh: 我对此的本能反应是，索马里不在我潜在的报道地点地图上，因为它传统上被认为非常困难且危险。

sentences.en: But they suggested that it would be possible, and as I saw how dependent Somalia was on not only imported food, but also imported fertilizer coming out of the Strait of Hormuz,
sentences.zh: 但他们暗示这是可行的，而且当我看到索马里不仅多么依赖进口食品，还多么依赖来自霍尔木兹海峡的进口化肥时，

sentences.en: I realized that it was the perfect place to see up close this grave test of what one person put it to me as the post-aid era.
sentences.zh: 我意识到这是近距离观察正如某人对我所说的“后援助时代”严峻考验的绝佳地点。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Talk to us about your trip to Somalia.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲你的索马里之行吧。

sentences.en: What did you find going on there?
sentences.zh: 你在那里发现了什么情况？

sentences.en: Well, it's important to say right at the top that Somalia was already in a very precarious situation before the war started.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先最重要的是要说，在战争爆发之前，索马里就已经处于非常岌岌可危的境地。

sentences.en: There was, you know, as I mentioned before, a severe drought.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前提到的，那里有严重的干旱。

sentences.en: There had been several droughts in a row.
sentences.zh: 已经连续发生了好几次旱灾。

sentences.en: These had devastated the food supply.
sentences.zh: 这些灾害摧毁了粮食供应。

sentences.en: You've got armed conflict.
sentences.zh: 你还有武装冲突。

sentences.en: And then you've got these dramatic cuts to the aid system before this war.
sentences.zh: 然后在这场战争之前，援助系统又遭到了急剧的削减。

sentences.en: So Somalia imports something like 70% of its food and 90% of its energy.
sentences.zh: 所以索马里大约70%的食品和90%的能源都依赖进口。

sentences.en: And because so much shipping has been disrupted by the shutdown of the Strait of Hormuz and, to a lesser extent, the Red Sea.
sentences.zh: 由于霍尔木兹海峡的关闭以及在较小程度上红海的关闭，大量的航运受到了干扰。

sentences.en: You've got several weeks of delays getting supplies into ports in the Horn of Africa.
sentences.zh: 将物资运入非洲之角港口的时间延迟了好几周。

sentences.en: And so the price of food and fuel has more than doubled since the war.
sentences.zh: 因此，自战争爆发以来，食品和燃料的价格已经翻了一番多。

sentences.en: You're describing a series of cascading events that all could lead to these potentially catastrophic results.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的是一连串层层叠加的事件，所有这些都可能导致这些潜在的灾难性后果。

sentences.en: I want to go through them one by one.
sentences.zh: 我想逐一过一遍。

sentences.en: Let's start with the food situation.
sentences.zh: 我们从食品情况开始。

sentences.en: Right, so in Mogadishu, which is the capital of Somalia, I went to a fish market and there were these guys wielding machetes to hack sharks and tuna into steaks.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以在索马里首都摩加迪沙，我去了一个鱼市，那里有一些家伙挥舞着砍刀把鲨鱼和金枪鱼剁成牛排状的鱼块。

sentences.en: I talked to a woman who was running a stand there, Fatou Manor,
sentences.zh: 我采访了一位在那里经营摊位的妇人，法图·马诺（Fatou Manor），

sentences.en: and she was telling me that wholesale prices have gone up because the fishing boats can't afford to buy as much diesel as they used to,
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，批发价格已经上涨，因为渔船买不起像以前那么多柴油了，

sentences.en: which means they can't go out to the deeper waters where the biggest fish are.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们无法去到最大鱼类所在的深水区。

sentences.en: They're staying closer to the shore, which is depleting the catch, which is limiting the supply of fish.
sentences.zh: 他们只能留在离海岸更近的地方，这正在耗尽渔获量，从而限制了鱼类供应。

sentences.en: So she has to pay more, and as a result, she has to charge her customers more, so her sales are down half, and she's actually worried about going bankrupt as a result of this.
sentences.zh: 所以她必须支付更多进货成本，结果她也不得不向顾客收取更高价格，因此她的销量下降了一半，她实际上正为此担心自己会破产。

sentences.en: And Somalia, of course, is a country where a lot of people already had trouble affording food.
sentences.zh: 当然，索马里是一个许多人本来就难以负担得起食物的国家。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But what about the people who, even before the Iran war, could not afford to go to this market and purchase the sharks that are being cut up, the fish that she is selling?
sentences.zh: 但是对于那些甚至在伊朗战争之前就买不起这个市场上的鲨鱼、买不起她所卖的鱼的人呢？

sentences.en: What have they been doing since prices have only gone up?
sentences.zh: 自从价格只涨不跌以来，他们一直在靠什么过活？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I talked to, I don't even know how many families who said, we don't know where our next meal is coming from.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我采访了——我都不知道有多少家庭——他们说，我们不知道下一顿饭在哪里。

sentences.en: We're lucky if we can feed our children one meal a day.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能让孩子一天吃上一顿饭，我们就很幸运了。

sentences.en: Lots of families are now subsisting on, you know, sorghum porridge with weeds that they're finding by riverbanks, and the drought is even eliminating that.
sentences.zh: 许多家庭现在仅靠高粱粥度日，里面还要掺杂他们在河岸边找到的杂草，而且干旱甚至连这也正在剥夺。

sentences.en: This is the drought that existed before, but what struck me was how UNICEF, for one example, they're trucking water to drought-afflicted areas,
sentences.zh: 这就是之前就存在的干旱，但令我震惊的是，以联合国儿童基金会为例，他们用卡车向受旱灾影响的地区运送水，

sentences.en: and they were already dealing with budget cuts.
sentences.zh: 而他们当时就已经在应对预算削减了。

sentences.en: Well, now the price of diesel goes up, so the price of trucking that water is much more expensive, so now they're trucking less water.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在柴油价格上涨了，所以用卡车运送这些水的成本高得多，因此现在他们运的水变少了。

sentences.en: Well, now that they're trucking less water, there are more people in need who can no longer stay in the places that used to be relying upon that water.
sentences.zh: 嗯，既然他们现在用卡车运送的水少了，就有更多有需要的人无法再待在原本依赖这些水度日的地方了。

sentences.en: They have to go move somewhere in search of aid in the places like the ones I visited in camps along the Ethiopian border.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不离开，去别处寻求援助，就像我访问过的那些沿着埃塞俄比亚边境的难民营一样。

sentences.en: So what did you see when you visited those camps, and what did the people there tell you?
sentences.zh: 那你访问这些难民营时看到了什么？那里的人对你说了什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, this was gutting.
sentences.zh: 对，这真是让人心碎。

sentences.en: On my first day in the town of Dolo on the Ethiopian border, the sort of place where traditionally large international relief groups, World Food Program, UNICEF, have clustered,
sentences.zh: 在我到达埃塞俄比亚边境的多洛镇的第一天，那是个传统上大型国际救援组织（如世界粮食计划署、联合国儿童基金会）聚集的地方，

sentences.en: I met a family that had left a rural area where the drought had been particularly severe.
sentences.zh: 我遇到了一家人，他们离开了一个干旱极其严重的农村地区。

sentences.en: It had killed their 50 head of cattle.
sentences.zh: 干旱夺走了他们50头牛。

sentences.en: That's their life savings.
sentences.zh: 那是他们的全部积蓄。

sentences.en: Once that's gone, they've got nothing.
sentences.zh: 一旦那些没了，他们就一无所有了。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the rivers have dried up.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，河流已经干涸。

sentences.en: They can't grow any food, so they walked for nine days carrying their three-year-old daughter on their backs.
sentences.zh: 他们无法种植任何食物，于是背着三岁的女儿步行了九天。

sentences.en: And they get there to Dolo, and they discover that all of these international relief groups, almost all of them, have abandoned the area.
sentences.zh: 等他们到达多洛时，却发现所有这些国际救援组织，几乎全都没有了，他们已经离开了这个地区。

sentences.en: There's no help.
sentences.zh: 没有任何帮助。

sentences.en: Did they tell you how it felt to arrive only to find out that this was just an aid camp with no aid?
sentences.zh: 他们有没有告诉你，历经千辛万苦到达这里，却发现这只是个没有援助的援助营地，当时是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I mean, they were in disbelief.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: And they understood, like most of the people in these camps, they can't go back.
sentences.zh: 他们也明白，就像这些营地里的大多数人一样，他们回不去了。

sentences.en: They set up a tent alongside hundreds of others with some plastic sheeting that gets donated by some other people in the camp.
sentences.zh: 他们在其他营地居民捐赠的一些塑料布下，和其他几百个帐篷搭在一起。

sentences.en: They find some sticks, and they set up this shelter, and they're just waiting and hoping that some aid will return.
sentences.zh: 他们找了一些棍子，搭建了这个避难所，只是在等待并期盼着某种援助能够重新到来。

sentences.en: What you are describing is a mass starvation crisis in the making, if not already here.
sentences.zh: 你所描述的正在酝酿一场大规模的饥荒危机，如果现在还算不上已经发生的话。

sentences.en: Can you talk a little bit about what treatment is available for people who do not have enough food, for these children who do not have enough food?
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈对于那些没有足够食物的人，对于这些没有足够食物的孩子，目前有什么样的治疗方法吗？

sentences.en: And has that changed also as a result of the war?
sentences.zh: 这也是否因为战争而发生了变化？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's changed dramatically.
sentences.zh: 是的，这发生了巨大的变化。

sentences.en: I think maybe the most harrowing thing I saw, I was taken to a UNICEF ward of a hospital in Mogadishu, where the most severe malnourishment cases are taken.
sentences.zh: 我想也许我看到的最痛心的事是，我被带到摩加迪沙一家医院的联合国儿童基金会病房，那里收治的都是最严重的营养不良病例。

sentences.en: This hospital has seen a doubling of cases in the last few months.
sentences.zh: 这家医院在过去几个月里，病例数量翻了一番。

sentences.en: This is since the disruptions of the war.
sentences.zh: 这是自战争引发混乱以来的情况。

sentences.en: I saw babies needing feeding tubes and oxygen to be kept alive.
sentences.zh: 我看到婴儿需要靠喂食管和氧气来维持生命。

sentences.en: Is this okay?
sentences.zh: 这样可以吗？

sentences.en: And I talked through a translator with a mother who was sitting next to her 18-month-old baby boy leaning up alongside her.
sentences.zh: 我通过翻译与一位母亲交谈，她坐在她18个月大的男婴身旁，孩子无力地靠在她身边。

sentences.en: So she's sitting.
sentences.zh: 所以她坐着。

sentences.en: The river dried up, so they cannot cultivate.
sentences.zh: 河水干涸了，所以他们无法耕种。

sentences.en: So they lost their crops, so they got hungry.
sentences.zh: 因此他们失去了庄稼，所以他们饿了。

sentences.en: And her son began vomiting.
sentences.zh: 然后她的儿子开始呕吐。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: And when her infant son couldn't hold down any food, she had to beg to get $24 to get her child to the city in a place where farm laborers are making a dollar a day.
sentences.zh: 当她幼小的儿子吃不下任何食物时，她不得不去乞讨24美元，好把孩子送到城里去——在一个农场工人的日薪只有一美元的地方。

sentences.en: And he was actually a quote-unquote positive outcome.
sentences.zh: 而且他实际上算是一个所谓的“积极结果”。

sentences.en: Oh, that's it?
sentences.zh: 哦，就这样吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Another three or four days?
sentences.zh: 再过三四天？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He was about to be discharged.
sentences.zh: 他快要出院了。

sentences.en: Okay, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I love you.
sentences.zh: 我爱你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: But here was the part of this that was most striking to me.
sentences.zh: 但最让我触动的是这一部分。

sentences.en: The doctors there told me a third of these cases they think could have been avoided had these kids been assessed and treated earlier.
sentences.zh: 那里的医生告诉我，如果这些孩子能早点得到评估和治疗，他们认为其中三分之一的病例是可以避免的。

sentences.en: Now, UNICEF has been forced to close 205 health and nutrition centers throughout Somalia.
sentences.zh: 现在，联合国儿童基金会被迫关闭了索马里境内的205个健康与营养中心。

sentences.en: If those centers were still there,
sentences.zh: 如果这些中心还在的话，

sentences.en: then a lot of these kids ending up in the hospital needing oxygen to breathe and feeding tubes to stay alive would be treated and assessed earlier.
sentences.zh: 那么许多最后住进医院、需要靠氧气呼吸和靠喂食管维持生命的儿童，就能更早地得到治疗和评估。

sentences.en: Peter, you mentioned that Somalia was already facing a cascading series of crises even before the Iran war.
sentences.zh: 彼得，你提到索马里甚至在伊朗战争之前就面临着一连串层出不穷的危机。

sentences.en: Do we have any way to quantify how much worse the humanitarian crisis has gotten?
sentences.zh: 我们有没有办法量化人道主义危机究竟恶化到了什么程度？

sentences.en: Well, let me put it to you this way.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我这么跟你说吧。

sentences.en: In February, so this is before the impacts of the Iran war, the UN Food and Agriculture Organization warns that there are six and a half million people in Somalia.
sentences.zh: 在二月份，也就是伊朗战争的影响爆发之前，联合国粮农组织就警告说，索马里有六百五十万人。

sentences.en: That's about a third of the population that are suffering hunger at levels that are deemed an emergency.
sentences.zh: 大约占人口的三分之一，正在遭受被视为紧急状态级别的饥饿。

sentences.en: And early last year, the World Food Program, which is the largest source of food aid in the country, has funds to serve as many as two million people a month.
sentences.zh: 去年年初，作为该国最大的粮食援助来源，世界粮食计划署有资金每月为多达两百万人提供服务。

sentences.en: Well, when I was there, this is late April, early May, they were down to funds that were adequate to serve 300,000 people a month.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我在那里时，那是四月下旬、五月初，他们的资金只够每月为三十万人提供服务。

sentences.en: And that was going to run out at the end of June.
sentences.zh: 而且那些资金到六月底就要用完了。

sentences.en: So from two million to 300,000 a month and no more come July.
sentences.zh: 所以从每月两百万减少到三十万，到了七月就彻底没有了。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I actually got a snapshot of this aid running out in real time in Somalia.
sentences.zh: 而且我实际上在索马里实时见证了这种援助耗尽的全过程。

sentences.en: So I went to visit a World Food Program warehouse.
sentences.zh: 所以我去参观了一个世界粮食计划署的仓库。

sentences.en: So this is two months supply.
sentences.zh: 所以这是两个月的供应量。

sentences.en: Yeah, two months supply.
sentences.zh: 是的，两个月的供应量。

sentences.en: This is a place that felt like a fortress, you know, high walls topped by barbed wire.
sentences.zh: 这个地方感觉像个堡垒，你知道的，高高的墙上顶着带刺的铁丝网。

sentences.en: And I walked through that facility with the director, Josephine Mouly.
sentences.zh: 我和主管约瑟芬·穆利一起走过了那个设施。

sentences.en: Josephine, so when you first started here two years ago, how many of these tents were full?
sentences.zh: 约瑟芬，两年前你刚来这里的时候，这些帐篷里有多少是满的？

sentences.en: Basically, we used to have full capacity.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我们以前是满负荷运转的。

sentences.en: She showed me these 13 A-frame tents that normally would be full of food aid, and 12 of these 13 tents were empty.
sentences.zh: 她给我看了这13个A字形帐篷，平时里面应该都塞满了粮食援助，而这13个帐篷中有12个都是空的。

sentences.en: So we're in the one tent that actually does have some supplies, and it's...
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在在唯一一个确实还有物资的帐篷里，而且它……

sentences.en: We went inside this one tent that was full, and there were these brown cartons.
sentences.zh: 我们走进了这唯一一个满着的帐篷，里面有一些棕色的纸箱。

sentences.en: These cardboard boxes stamped with the USAID logo and American flags says made in USAID.
sentences.zh: 这些纸板箱上印有美国国际开发署的标志和美国国旗，上面写着美国国际开发署制造。

sentences.en: They were full of plumpy nut, which is this peanut-rich nutrient paste that's fed to malnourished children and pregnant and breastfeeding moMs.
sentences.zh: 里面装满了“普伦皮坚果”，这是一种富含花生的营养糊剂，用来喂养营养不良的儿童以及孕妇和哺乳期母亲。

sentences.en: And this was the last of it.
sentences.zh: 而这已经是最后一点了。

sentences.en: There was nothing else in the pipeline.
sentences.zh: 后续管道里什么都没有了。

sentences.en: Up to June, June, July.
sentences.zh: 直到六月，六月，七月。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: If we don't get any funding, we'll be dry completely, completely.
sentences.zh: 如果我们得不到任何资金，我们将彻底、彻底地断粮。

sentences.en: We can't respond.
sentences.zh: 我们无能为力。

sentences.en: And I asked the director, quite bluntly...
sentences.zh: 我开门见山地问主管……

sentences.en: And then what happens to the population?
sentences.zh: 那民众会怎么样？

sentences.en: What are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 你们打算怎么办？

sentences.en: I would ask you the same question.
sentences.zh: 我也想问你同样的问题。

sentences.en: It really brought home for me that these aid workers are now in a position where they're having to contemplate this surreal hierarchy of suffering where, you know,
sentences.zh: 这真的让我深刻意识到，这些救援人员现在不得不面对这种超现实的苦难等级体系，你知道的，

sentences.en: as one World Food Program official put it to me, we're deciding who lives today and who dies in two weeks.
sentences.zh: 正如世界粮食计划署的一位官员对我说的那样，我们正在决定谁能活到今天，谁将在两周后死去。

sentences.en: Peter, how representative is what you saw in Somalia of the downstream effects of this war in the other countries that you have been focused on?
sentences.zh: 彼得，你在索马里看到的情景，在你所关注的其他国家中，在多大程度上代表了这场战争的下游效应？

sentences.en: Well, look, Somalia goes into this crisis especially vulnerable, but it is very much representative in that the trajectory is the same.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看，索马里陷入这场危机时格外脆弱，但它在发展轨迹上是完全相同的，极具代表性。

sentences.en: So in Sudan, which is widely considered the world's most dire humanitarian crisis at the moment, where you already have parts of the country in officially declared famine, well,
sentences.zh: 所以在苏丹，目前被普遍认为是世界上最严峻的人道主义危机，该国部分地区已经正式宣布发生饥荒，嗯，

sentences.en: now in Port Sudan, the primary gateway for food aid in Sudan, you have stuff coming in weeks later.
sentences.zh: 现在在苏丹粮食援助的主要入口苏丹港，物资要推迟数周才能运进来。

sentences.en: And then the head of UNICEF for Sudan told me it's difficult to get that stuff trucked to places that are stricken by famine because not only is the price of diesel so expensive,
sentences.zh: 然后苏丹的联合国儿童基金会负责人告诉我，很难把这些物资用卡车运到遭受饥荒袭击的地方，因为不仅柴油价格极其昂贵，

sentences.en: but the trucking companies are unwilling to take the risk of bringing their trucks into the hinterland because there are actual physical shortages of diesel fuel in the center of the country.
sentences.zh: 而且货运公司不愿意冒着把卡车开进内地腹地的风险，因为苏丹中部地区实际上存在柴油燃料的物理短缺。

sentences.en: They're worried they're going to get stuck there.
sentences.zh: 他们担心自己会被困在那里。

sentences.en: They're worried they're going to get stuck there.
sentences.zh: 他们担心自己会被困在那里。

sentences.en: So I just came back from Ivory Coast, which is one of the fastest growing economies on Earth.
sentences.zh: 所以我刚从科特迪瓦回来，那是地球上增长最快的经济体之一。

sentences.en: This is in West Africa.
sentences.zh: 这在西非。

sentences.en: And there you have cocoa farmers who have already been suffering from dramatically reduced prices for their crops.
sentences.zh: 在那里，可可农民已经因为农作物价格大幅下跌而遭受痛苦。

sentences.en: Now they're looking at increased prices for fertilizer, which means lower yields, lower livelihoods, and on it goes.
sentences.zh: 现在他们又面临化肥价格上涨，这意味着产量下降、生计恶化，诸如此类，没完没了。

sentences.en: Peter, one of the things that we have talked about on this show a lot since the war began was that even if it ended tomorrow, even if the Strait of Hormuz opened tomorrow,
sentences.zh: 彼得，自战争爆发以来，我们在节目中经常讨论的一点是，即使它明天就结束，即使霍尔木兹海峡明天就重新开放，

sentences.en: enough damage has been done to energy infrastructure in the Persian Gulf that the disruptions to energy supplies could go on for years.
sentences.zh: 波斯湾的能源基础设施已经受到了足够的破坏，以至于对能源供应的中断可能会持续多年。

sentences.en: And I wonder whether you foresee that same kind of more lasting disruption in the countries that we've talked about today.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，在你今天谈到的这些国家里，你是否也预见到那种更持久的中断？

sentences.en: Look, a lot of what we're talking about here will change people's lives forever.
sentences.zh: 听着，我们在这里讨论的很多事情将永远改变人们的生活。

sentences.en: Now, will some of it return to normal when the Strait reopens?
sentences.zh: 那么，海峡重新开放时，其中一些会恢复正常吗？

sentences.en: Maybe some of it.
sentences.zh: 也许会有一部分吧。

sentences.en: Sure, fuel prices presumably will go back down.
sentences.zh: 当然，燃料价格大概会回落。

sentences.en: Fertilizer will be more available and food prices could come back down and that could have a lot of benefit.
sentences.zh: 化肥会更容易获得，食品价格也可能会回落，这可能会带来很多好处。

sentences.en: But you have to look at things a little more expansively than that.
sentences.zh: 但你必须以更广阔的视角来看待这些事情。

sentences.en: I mean, again, think about the butterfly effect, all of the ripple effects that can't be undone in a few weeks or maybe even years.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，再想想蝴蝶效应，所有那些无法在几周甚至几年内消除的连锁反应。

sentences.en: I mean, I went to a training program in Dolo in Somalia that used to be funded by USAID.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我去索马里多洛参观了一个培训项目，该项目以前由美国国际开发署资助。

sentences.en: It trained people to be seamstresses.
sentences.zh: 它培训人们成为裁缝。

sentences.en: And when I was there, they had no threat.
sentences.zh: 而我在那里的时候，他们没有线。

sentences.en: They didn't have chemicals for their sewing machines.
sentences.zh: 他们没有缝纫机用的化学品。

sentences.en: And enrollment had crashed.
sentences.zh: 报名人数已经暴跌。

sentences.en: Now, this is not the most acutely needed sort of program if you're thinking about feeding people tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你考虑的是让人民明天就有饭吃，这并不是最急需的那种项目。

sentences.en: But it's vital in terms of building up some upward mobility.
sentences.zh: 但对于建立某种向上的流动性而言，它至关重要。

sentences.en: Think about that times a million.
sentences.zh: 把这放大一百万倍想想看。

sentences.en: You know, Rachel, I've been doing this sort of work a long time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，蕾切尔，我做这种工作已经很久了。

sentences.en: I spent a lot of time in conflict zones and disasters.
sentences.zh: 我在冲突区和灾区度过了很长时间。

sentences.en: You know, in 2004, I was in Thailand the day of the tsunami.
sentences.zh: 你知道，2004年海啸发生那天我在泰国。

sentences.en: I went to Indonesia, and I saw and heard stories that will haunt me forever.
sentences.zh: 我去了印度尼西亚，我看到并听到的故事将永远萦绕在我心头。

sentences.en: I saw 200 bodies in Thailand set up at this makeshift morgue lying out in the sun.
sentences.zh: 我在泰国看到200具尸体摆在这个临时停尸房里，躺在阳光下。

sentences.en: I heard parents recounting how their children had been yanked out of their arms by this wave.
sentences.zh: 我听到父母们叙述他们的孩子是如何被这股海啸从他们怀里强行夺走的。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't really like the sort of Olympics of suffering.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我其实不太喜欢这种苦难奥林匹克。

sentences.en: And yet, what I saw in Somalia was enraging as well as gutting.
sentences.zh: 然而，我在索马里看到的情景既让人愤怒又让人心碎。

sentences.en: Because what happened in the Indian Ocean tsunami was, as they say, an act of God.
sentences.zh: 因为印度洋海啸发生时，正如他们所说，那是天灾。

sentences.en: And what I was seeing in Somalia was the product of a series of political decisions.
sentences.zh: 而我在索马里看到的一切是一系列政治决策的产物。

sentences.en: It was made by human beings.
sentences.zh: 那是人为造成的。

sentences.en: You have hundreds of millions of people who, by dint of climate change, cuts to the aid system, the impacts of the war,
sentences.zh: 由于气候变化、援助系统削减、战争的影响，你们有数亿人，

sentences.en: are now in these sort of purgatory situations, and we're still at the beginning stages of it.
sentences.zh: 现在正处于这种炼狱般的境地，而我们还只是处于这一切的初期阶段。

sentences.en: There's a long way down to go from here.
sentences.zh: 从这里开始，还有很长的一段路要跌下去。

sentences.en: Peter Goodman, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 彼得·古德曼，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，蕾切尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Early Wednesday morning, the United States and Iran exchanged military attacks in the Middle East,
sentences.zh: 周三清晨，美国和伊朗在中东地区进行了军事交火，

sentences.en: a severe escalation after the downing of an American helicopter gunship earlier in the week.
sentences.zh: 这是继本周早些时候美军武装直升机被击落后的一次严重升级。

sentences.en: Acting on orders from President Trump, U.S.
sentences.zh: 根据特朗普总统的命令，美国

sentences.en: Central Command launched what it called self-defense operations near the Strait of Hormuz, striking Iranian air defenses, ground control stations, and surveillance radar sites.
sentences.zh: 中央司令部在霍尔木兹海峡附近展开了所谓的自卫行动，打击了伊朗的防空系统、地面控制站和监视雷达站。

sentences.en: The scale of the damage is not yet clear.
sentences.zh: 破坏规模目前尚不清楚。

sentences.en: In response, Iran claimed to launch drone strikes targeting the U.S.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，伊朗声称对驻巴林的美国

sentences.en: Navy's 5th Fleet in Bahrain, along with 21 attacks on U.S.
sentences.zh: 海军第五舰队发动了无人机袭击，并对分布在整个地区的美国

sentences.en: bases across the region.
sentences.zh: 基地发动了21次袭击。

sentences.en: But U.S.
sentences.zh: 但美国

sentences.en: officials report that nearly all of the incoming missiles and drones were intercepted, and there have been no reports of American casualties or damage to U.S.
sentences.zh: 官员报告称，几乎所有来袭的导弹和无人机都被拦截了，根据美国初步评估，没有美军伤亡或美军

sentences.en: bases, according to initial American assessments.
sentences.zh: 基地受损的报告。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Adrienne Hurst, Michelle Bonja, and Claire Tennisgetter.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由阿德里安娜·赫斯特、米歇尔·邦贾和克莱尔·特尼斯盖特制作。

sentences.en: With help from Diana Nguyen, it was edited by Chris Haxel and Michael Benoit.
sentences.zh: 在黛安娜·阮的协助下，由克里斯·哈克塞尔和迈克尔·布努瓦剪辑。

sentences.en: With help from Lizzo Balin, it contains music by Dan Powell and Leah Shaw Demeron.
sentences.zh: 在莉佐·巴林的协助下，其中包含丹·鲍威尔和莉亚·肖·德梅隆的音乐。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由Wonderly创作。

sentences.en: This episode was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 本期节目的音频工程由克里斯·伍德负责。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》到此结束。

sentences.en: I'm Rachel AbraMs.
sentences.zh: 我是雷切尔·艾布拉姆斯。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运转。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》的最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格将为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 都市。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
